title: Will "expectations" rank No. 1–2 on Billboard Hot 100? Rank 1 to 2
rules: If "expectations" by Olivia Rodrigo & Chappell Roan ranks between No. 1 and No. 2, inclusive on the Billboard Hot 100 for the chart dated Oct 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Billboard. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

blind.reasoning: The Rodrigo/Roan remix of 'expectations' was released Oct. 15, so the Oct. 31 chart covers its first full week. The original album track only debuted at No. 20 in June, and remixes of album tracks rarely reach the top two even with combined credit and sales pushes. A top-10 jump is plausible, but reaching No. 1–2 needs exceptional first-week numbers and weak competition, which I could not check.
blind.falsifier: Early tracking or first-week streaming and sales reports showing the remix leading the Hot 100 race, for example by topping the U.S. Spotify daily chart for most of Oct. 16–22 with heavy digital sales.

final.reasoning: The 36.5% midpoint likely reflects early streaming data I couldn't see, so I moved up from 18% to 27%. Remixes of album tracks rarely reach No. 1–2, and the market still looks rich relative to that history, so I'd take NO.
